title: EntityTypeDef
description: Per-entity-type definition loaded from the content YAML.

build_cost.description: Total construction or upgrade cost, keyed by resource ID. Spent progressively at the producer's spend_rates; omitted means no cost.

builds.description: Units this entity type can produce.

collector.description: Optional automatic resource collection capabilities. Omit to disable collection.

combat.description:
Optional autonomous-combat profile. When present, the server acquires
nearby hostile entities and drives the unit according to its strategy.

combat_targetable.description:
Whether autonomous combat may select this entity type as a target.
Defaults to false so scenery and resource entities are safe by default.

fog_memory.description: Client behavior when this entity leaves sensor coverage.

health.description: Hull hit points before the entity is destroyed.

hull_radius.description:
Physical hull radius in world units used by contact attacks. Defaults to 0.
Independent of visual scale and movement-order stop radius.

maintenance_cost_per_minute.description:
Upkeep in resource units per minute, keyed by resource ID. Added to sensor operating costs.
Charged to the owner while active; balances stop at zero without accruing debt. Omitted means free upkeep.

mass.description: Mass used to convert random physics forces to acceleration (force / mass). Use a positive value.

radiation_shielding.description: Shielding keyed by radiation type ID. Missing types use zero distance offset and a damage multiplier of 1.

radiation_sources.description: Environmental hazard emitters attached to this entity type.

refinery.description: Optional drop-off point for resources carried by transport collectors.

requires_technologies.description:
Technologies the player must own before building or upgrading into this type.
Use a technology ID or nested all/any groups; omitted means no prerequisites.

researches.description: Technology IDs this entity can research. Omitted or empty means it cannot perform research.

resource_node.description: Optional resource source that collectors can gather from.

sensor.description: Optional area sensor. Its operating costs are charged continuously.

speed.description: Maximum movement speed in world units per second.

stop_radius.description: Distance from a movement target at which this entity stops, in world units.

suppress_hover.description: Whether the client should suppress hover UI for this entity type.

upgrades.description: Entity types this entity may transform into through an upgrade channel.

visibility_range.description:
Distance in world units at which this entity can be detected from an owned sensor source.
Detection uses the larger of this value and the source's sensor range. Omitted means 0.

visual.description: Client-only presentation settings for the entity's rendered sprite.

z_index.description: Draw order within the world layer. Higher values render in front.

contact_tolerance.description: Extra distance in world units beyond the sum of both hull radii for dismantle. Defaults to 0; negative values act as 0.

cooldown_ticks.description: Simulation ticks before this weapon can fire again. Values below 1 are treated as 1.

damage.description: Hit points removed per successful attack, not per second.

id.description: Stable weapon ID within this entity type; identifies its cooldown and breaks equal-priority ties alphabetically.

priority.description: Higher numbers win among weapons in range; ties use the alphabetically first ID. Defaults to 0.

range.description: Maximum center-to-center laser distance in world units. Defaults to 0; ignored for dismantle.

type.description: Weapon behavior: laser uses range; dismantle uses both hull radii plus contact_tolerance.

oneOf.description: Ranged attack using the weapon's range in world units.
Contact attack within attacker hull radius + target hull radius + contact_tolerance.

BuildOptionDef.description: One content-defined production option available to a builder.

entity_type_id.description: ID of the entity type this entity can build.

spend_rates.description: Resource units spent per second, keyed by resource ID, toward the target's build_cost. Missing rates default to 1/s.

oneOf.description: Solar collection particle presentation. Visual only; does not select the resource collection mode.
Mineral transport particle presentation. Visual only; does not select the resource collection mode.

CollectionMode.description: Collection mode for a resource source.

oneOf.description: Gather into the collector's cargo, then deliver to an accepting refinery to credit the owner's resources.
Credit the owner's resources directly while a collector remains within the source's effective distance band.

CollectorDef.description: Automatic resource collector capabilities and rates.

carry_capacity.description: Max carried amount for transport mode before deposit run.

collects.description: Resource type ids this collector can gather.

deposit_entity_types.description:
Optional allowed refinery entity type ids for transport deposits.
Empty means any refinery that accepts the resource.

proximity_rate_per_second.description: Units/second gathered in proximity mode while in effective band.

transport_rate_per_second.description: Units/second gathered in transport mode while in gather band.

vfx.description: Client presentation profile for collection particle effects.

CombatDef.description:
Data needed for server-authoritative autonomous combat.

Timings are ticks, rather than seconds, so a combat replay is a pure
function of the content version and tick stream.

acquisition_range.description: Maximum distance at which this unit acquires a hostile target.

attacks.description: Weapons available to this entity. Their stable IDs also key cooldowns.

on_near_enemy_strategy.description: How this unit responds after acquiring a nearby hostile.

oneOf.description: Keep the last observed entity state after it leaves sensor coverage.
Remove the entity from the client's visible state when it leaves sensor coverage.

NearEnemyStrategy.description: Autonomous movement response to a nearby hostile entity.

oneOf.description: Move into weapon range, then fire. This preserves existing NPC behavior.
Move directly away from the nearest hostile without firing.
Do not move; fire only if the hostile is already in weapon range.

RadiationShieldingDef.description: Per-radiation-type shielding profile for an entity type.

damage_multiplier.description:
Multiplier for incoming radiation damage after distance adjustment. Defaults to 1; 0 gives immunity.
Negative values act as 0.

distance_offset.description:
World units added to actual source distance before checking radiation bands and falloff.
Defaults to 0; negative values act as 0.

RadiationSourceDef.description: Environmental radiation emitted by an entity type.

damage_per_second.description: Hit points removed per second within the full-strength band, before shielding. Defaults to 0 (no damage).

full_damage_distance.description:
End of the full-strength damage band in world units. Damage then falls linearly to zero at max_effective_distance.
Defaults to 0 and is clamped between the inner and outer radii.

full_damage_distance_border_color.description:
Optional full-damage-distance range outline color: 3 or 6 hex digits, e.g. "#f80" or "#ff8800".
Quote values beginning with # in YAML. Omitted means no outline; visual only.

full_damage_distance_fill_color.description:
Optional full-damage-distance range fill color: 3 or 6 hex digits, e.g. "#f80" or "#ff8800".
Quote values beginning with # in YAML. Omitted means no fill; visual only.

max_effective_distance.description: Outer damage radius in world units; targets beyond this take no damage. Defaults to 120; clamped to at least the inner radius.

max_effective_distance_border_color.description:
Optional max-effective-distance range outline color: 3 or 6 hex digits, e.g. "#f80" or "#ff8800".
Quote values beginning with # in YAML. Omitted means no outline; visual only.

max_effective_distance_fill_color.description:
Optional max-effective-distance range fill color: 3 or 6 hex digits, e.g. "#f80" or "#ff8800".
Quote values beginning with # in YAML. Omitted means no fill; visual only.

min_effective_distance.description: Inner damage radius in world units; targets closer than this take no damage. Defaults to 0. Shielding adjusts distance first.

min_effective_distance_border_color.description:
Optional min-effective-distance range outline color: 3 or 6 hex digits, e.g. "#f80" or "#ff8800".
Quote values beginning with # in YAML. Omitted means no outline; visual only.

min_effective_distance_fill_color.description:
Optional min-effective-distance range fill color: 3 or 6 hex digits, e.g. "#f80" or "#ff8800".
Quote values beginning with # in YAML. Omitted means no fill; visual only.

radiation_type.description: Radiation type ID used to look up the target's radiation_shielding entry.

accepts.description: Resource type ids this structure accepts for deposit.

cost_per_min.description: Resource costs while actively repairing, in units per minute.

efficiency.description: Health restored per total resource unit consumed.

range.description: Maximum center-to-center repair distance in world units.

ResourceNodeDef.description: Resource source profile for entity types that can be gathered from.

collection_mode.description: Whether gathering fills cargo for delivery (transport) or credits resources directly (proximity).

max_effective_distance.description: Outer center-to-center gathering distance in world units, inclusive. Defaults to 120 and is clamped to at least the inner distance.

min_effective_distance.description: Inner center-to-center gathering distance in world units, inclusive. Defaults to 0.

resource_type.description: Resource ID produced by this source; must be included in the collector's collects list.

SensorDef.description: Content-defined sensor available to any entity type.

cost_per_minute.description: Per-resource operating cost, in units per minute.

range.description:
Circular detection radius in world units. For autonomous combat units,
this should be at least `combat.acquisition_range`.

anyOf.description: ID of a technology the player must own.

all.description: All listed prerequisites must be satisfied. Use a non-empty list of technology IDs or nested all/any groups.

any.description: At least one listed prerequisite must be satisfied. Use a non-empty list of technology IDs or nested all/any groups.

UpgradeOptionDef.description:
One content-defined in-place transformation available to an entity.

The target type's `build_cost` supplies the resource cost. A missing
required resource rate defaults to 1/s, matching production builds.

entity_type_id.description: ID of the entity type this entity transforms into.

spend_rates.description: Resource units spent per second, keyed by resource ID. Uses the target type's build_cost; missing rates default to 1/s.

rotate_deg.description: Clockwise rotation in degrees from the asset's native right-facing direction. Defaults to 0.

scale.description: Multiplier for the entity's rendered size.
